scope: Bounded cached-source pilot for native-compatible per-player xG and xA. Only explicit numeric expected_goals/expected_assists fields; absent fields abstain. Exact Opta code, FPL fixture, date, clubs, score and equal native/source minutes required.
selection: All 120 already frozen FotMob shot-conservation source responses. Use 2022/23 qualified FPL expected-statistic view and native 2023/24 as references. No additional source collection. Target only structurally absent pre-2022 expected fields; preserve all original FPL values.
precision: Both source fields are already published per-player expected-statistic values. Compare decimal values rounded to the same two decimal places, without regression calibration or loose tolerance. Unknowns and inactive/no-appearance records are not default zeros.
xGI: Derive xG+xA only after both input fields qualify; preserve original FPL xGI when available.
xGC: Not supported by direct source player-stat fields in this pilot. Keep missing; do not substitute xGOT faced or whole-match totals for partial appearances.
application: Pilot cannot mutate any canonical view or point ledger. Record field outcomes before deciding whether a larger current-season qualification/source lineage check is worthwhile. Historical deadline availability remains unqualified.
